unstuck_said.text: First contact via grounded comment on issue #67 (index Grey Ridge Base resources): answered the ingest question - CDP Bazaar x402 discovery API is keyless/paginated (resource URL at resource, payTo at accepts[].payTo, lastUpdated freshness), so Base resources are ingestible without a submission endpoint. Noted a nano:mainnet exact scheme beside the Base kinds would let the same routes settle with no wallet step and no token surface.
